spark_open.description: The creature is depicted in right-facing side profile standing on a patch of rocky ground. It has the overall size, posture, and fur of a wolf, but most of its body is covered in heavy, segmented, armor-like plating. The head, neck ruff, chest, belly fringe, and lower front legs show thick gray, white and tan wolf fur, while the back, sides, shoulders, hips, tail and much of all four legs are encased in overlapping dark slate-gray plates with tan edges. A paler cream-colored segmented underlayer with rows of oval holes is exposed along the mid-flank between the dorsal plates and the belly fur. The tail is long and fully armored, and the four clawed paws are visible at the ground.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged creature standing in right-facing side view on a patch of pebbles, with the furry head, neck, chest and lower front legs of a gray wolf combined with extensive segmented armor over the back, sides and hindquarters. The head is wolf-like with shaggy gray and white fur, the back from behind the head to the tip of the tail and the hind legs are sheathed in overlapping dark blue-gray hard plates, the mid-flank shows a pale ribbed exoskeleton with oval holes, and a long tapering segmented armored tail curves down behind the body.

spark_open.description: The creature is a quadrupedal, wolf-like animal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of rocky, pebbly ground against a plain light background. Its overall shape, fur, head and paws are those of a large canid, but most of its dorsal and lateral surfaces, including the top of the head, neck, back, shoulders, hips, legs and tail, are covered in overlapping dark slate-blue to black armored plates with pale tan edges. The underside of the neck, chest, throat and parts of the legs show thick gray and white fur, while the mid-flank shows a paler segmented under-layer with rows of oval holes. The animal has a long tapering tail and four sturdy legs ending in clawed paws.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged wolf-like creature shown in right-facing profile standing on rocky ground. It has the head, muzzle, ears, fur, legs and paws of a gray wolf, but most of its upper body is covered in dark bluish-gray overlapping segmented armor plates like an armadillo or giant isopod, extending from the top of its head over its neck, back, sides, upper legs and long tapering tail. The throat, chest, belly and lower front legs show shaggy gray and white wolf fur, while the flanks show pale ribbed plating with oval openings. Its tail curves downward and is fully armored with small pointed projections underneath.
